hero.title: Master the Elements, Save the World
hero.description: In Elemental Havoc: Heroes Reborn, you will play as heroes with elemental powers, explore mysterious continents, fight against dark forces, and uncover the secrets of ancient civilizations!

intro.title: Game Introduction
intro.subtitle: Epic Elemental Combat Experience
intro.content: This is an open-world action adventure game independently created by a seven-person part-time team over eight years of dedication. In a fantasy wasteland after the collapse of elemental forces, become heroes of six unique classes, exploring dangerous ruins and wilderness. Master dynamic 'Elemental Reaction' combat, using wind, fire, water, and earth to create stunning combos.

items.title: Dynamic Elemental Combat System
items.description: Master the four elements of fire, water, earth, and wind. Create chain reactions through elemental combinations to achieve spectacular combat effects.

items.title: Vast Open World
items.description: Explore over 100 square kilometers of seamless maps, including forests, deserts, snow mountains, volcanoes, and more.

items.title: Multiplayer Cooperation & Competition
items.description: Support 4-player co-op to challenge epic bosses, or participate in PvP arenas to test your combat skills.

items.title: Deep Character Customization
items.description: Choose from 8 initial heroes, each with unique backstory and elemental affinity.

items.title: Epic Elemental Combat
items.description: Stunning skill effects and combat scenes

items.title: Vast Open World
items.description: Diverse ecological environments and hidden secrets

items.name: Flame Messenger - Ignis
items.description: Warrior from the volcanic lands, mastering destructive fire magic, skilled in area attacks and sustained damage.

items.name: Tidal Guardian - Aquia
items.description: Princess of the ocean kingdom, controlling water for attacks and healing, an indispensable support for the team.

items.name: Earth Guardian - Terra
items.description: Guardian of the ancient mountains, possessing powerful defensive and control skills, the team's frontline tank.

items.name: Storm Summoner - Zephyr
items.description: Mage of the sky city, harnessing storms and lightning, with extreme mobility and burst damage.
